description: VictoriaTraces Agent - accepts trace spans via OpenTelemetry protocol and replicates them across multiple VictoriaTraces instances.

kured, the Kubernetes reboot daemon: a DaemonSet that watches each node for a reboot-required sentinel and reboots nodes one at a time behind a lock, cordoning and draining first. Hardened by QuenchWorks as a minimal 0-CVE image, cosign-signed and pinned by digest.

vCluster runs a virtual Kubernetes cluster inside a namespace of a host cluster: its own API server and controller manager, with workloads synced to the host. Hardened by QuenchWorks as a nonroot, 0-CVE image with the 1.36 control plane built from source, cosign-signed and pinned by digest.
